title: Normalized proper/open pasting on ambient pro-etale and semilinear-system categories
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. All schemes are finite-type $k$-schemes; their structure morphisms need not be separated [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Choose either (a) $\mathcal D_T=D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A_n)$ for one fixed $n\ge1$, with ordinary unbounded derived module operations [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], or (b) $\mathcal D_T=D(\mathscr S_T)$, where $\mathscr S_T$ consists of module sheaves $M_n$ over $(A_n)_T$ and semilinear transition maps $M_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_{A_{n+1}\to A_n}M_n$, with componentwise morphisms commuting with transitions. In (b) use the simultaneous ringed-diagram-site operations of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections], not completed integral operations or derived maps chosen from their evaluations. Write $P_u\dashv S_u$ for exact inverse image and its total right-derived direct image, and $J_j\dashv P_j$ for exact extension by zero along an open immersion [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact]. Use ordinary derived tensor over the constant ring or over the ring system, respectively.

Let $d_{v,u}:P_uP_v\cong P_{vu}$ be the canonical pullback compositor, $c_{v,u}:S_vS_u\cong S_{vu}$ the inverse of its adjunction conjugate, and $e_{b,j}:J_bJ_j\cong J_{bj}$ the inverse open-adjunction conjugate of $P_jP_b\cong P_{bj}$. These are the canonical derived direct-image and open-extension compositors. They are natural, unital, associative, and identify the canonical adjunction for a composite with the composite adjunction [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction]. If $\mu_u:P_u(F\otimes G)\cong P_uF\otimes P_uG$ is canonical derived tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], then, after $d$ identifies pullbacks, $\mu_{vu}=\mu_u\circ P_u(\mu_v)$, with the arguments and tensor associators inserted. This assertion also fixes the tensor/composition coherence in setting (b).

For every commutative square
$$Q=\begin{array}{ccc}U&\xrightarrow{k_1}&V\\ r\downarrow&&\downarrow p\\ W&\xrightarrow{i}&Z\end{array},\qquad pk_1=ir,$$
with $p,r$ proper and $k_1,i$ quasi-compact open, form $V_W=V\times_ZW$ with projections $b:V_W\to V$, $q:V_W\to W$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. The induced $s=(k_1,r):U\to V_W$ is open and closed. Let $\operatorname{pr}_s:F\to J_sP_sF$ be identity on $s(U)$ and zero on its complementary open. Let $\beta:P_pJ_i\cong J_bP_q$ be canonical open base change, normalized by the open unit as in [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. Define
$$a_Q:P_pJ_i\xrightarrow{\beta}J_bP_q\xrightarrow{J_b\operatorname{pr}_sP_q}J_bJ_sP_sP_q\cong J_{k_1}P_r,$$
and define its proper-adjunction mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]
$$\Gamma_Q=S_p(J_{k_1}\varepsilon_r)\circ S_p(a_QS_r)\circ\eta_pJ_iS_r:J_iS_r\longrightarrow S_pJ_{k_1}.$$
This is precisely the normalized proper/open map used in [lem-sf-proper-open-projection-mate], also in setting (b). No Cartesian hypothesis is imposed.

For vertically stacked squares $Q_1,Q_2$ with left proper edges $r_1,r_2$, right proper edges $p_1,p_2$ and middle open $i_1$, the intrinsic clopen construction for their outer rectangle satisfies
$$\Gamma_{Q_2Q_1}=(S_{p_2}\Gamma_{Q_1})\circ(\Gamma_{Q_2}S_{r_1}).$$
For horizontally adjacent squares with top opens $k_1,k_2$, bottom opens $i_1,i_2$ and proper verticals $r,p,q$, it satisfies
$$\Gamma_{Q_2Q_1}=(\Gamma_{Q_2}J_{k_1})\circ(J_{i_2}\Gamma_{Q_1}).$$
Insert $c,d,e$ in these equations. Squares with identity verticals or identity horizontals give identity comparisons. The pasted $a_Q$ equals the intrinsic clopen-projection $a_Q$ for the outer square. The identities apply to refinement squares $(k_1,i,r,p)=(j_1,j_2,1,u)$ and to all intermediate squares in refining compatible compactification towers [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. They are identities of natural transformations on the entire stated unbounded categories, with no constructibility, Tor, etale-origin or normalized-system hypothesis. In (b) they hold before restriction of scalars, finite evaluation or total limit. No invertibility of $\Gamma_Q$ on arbitrary inputs is asserted.

lean.statement:
theorem ambientProperOpenPasting (F : WeilConjectures.FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (_hl : l ≠ F.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (n : ℕ) :
    (Laws (ordinary F (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))))) ∧
    OrdinaryTensorComposition F (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))) ∧
    Laws (systems F (WeilConjectures.IntegralSystemRealization.scalarRings l E)
      (WeilConjectures.IntegralSystemRealization.scalarTransitions l E)) ∧
    ∀ (o : WeilConjectures.IntegralSystemRealization.Operations l E)
      (c : WeilConjectures.IntegralSystemRealization.Compositors l E o),
      SystemTensorComposition F l E o c
